How do I set this on my X-M5?

    Assumes Dynamic Range 100% and D Range Priority Off. DR200/DR400 impose higher ISO floors. The camera’s meter makes the real exposure decision.

    Fujifilm X-M5 owner’s manual ↗
    Calculation & data notes

    This app estimates ambient-light exposure; it never meters the scene. Actual aperture and shutter enter the EV equation. Crop factor only affects shake guidance and angle of view.

    Subject speed, distance, output size and steady hands all matter. Aperture is a depth-of-field heuristic, not a measured depth-of-field result. Macro light loss, flash power and lens transmission are not modelled.

    Verified specifications & limitations ↗
    Install on iPhone & use offline

    Open the HTTPS website in Safari. Tap Share, then Add to Home Screen, and choose Add. If offered, enable Open as Web App.

    Load the app online once to prepare offline use.

    Camera profiles, lenses and calculations are included offline. Browser storage can be cleared by the device; reopen online if needed.
